problem: BB-P008 defines a deterministic HTML5 visual-evidence contract, but the production Defold runtime has no development-only state router/readiness bridge, exact-build binding, canonical local server or Playwright capture runner to implement it.

decision.rationale: Implement the validated BB-P008 contract directly: development-only Defold readiness/state provenance through window.__bebeeQA, exact source SHA injected by the Bob build path, isolated Playwright Chromium contexts and a release-negative check. Use a non-gameplay foundation_probe so the infrastructure can be proven without falsely claiming future movement/HUD/restoration fixtures exist.

research.candidate_pool_exception: Shipped-game competitor research is not applicable to deterministic build/test infrastructure; the governing evidence is the already-validated BB-P008 contract plus current engine/browser documentation.
research.reference_exception: No player-facing interaction or visual-quality decision is made by this harness ticket.

anti_pattern.observation: A browser screenshot taken after an arbitrary delay cannot prove application readiness or exact requested state.
anti_pattern.lesson: Use an explicit engine/browser testing bridge whose captureReady signal is authoritative.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Defold documents HTML5 browser automation for readiness, viewport control, console/JavaScript errors and screenshots, and recommends an explicit JavaScript testing bridge for reliable browser tests.
html5.run(code) synchronously executes JavaScript from Defold Lua and returns the browser result, providing the engine-to-page bridge used by the QA runtime.

Custom root game.properties settings are runtime-readable through sys.get_config_* and Bob accepts multiple settings files applied left-to-right, allowing mode flags and exact build provenance to stay explicit.
Playwright BrowserContexts provide isolated clean-slate browser sessions appropriate for order-independent deterministic captures.
Playwright for Python installs browser binaries separately and exposes Chromium automation through the Python library API.

alternatives.reason: Matches the validated BB-P008 architecture, provides isolated browser contexts and makes engine-owned capture readiness/state provenance explicit.

The existing CDP utilities remain useful narrow runtime smokes, but using them as the visual-QA framework would duplicate BrowserContext/capture facilities and diverge from the validated Playwright contract.
A fixed delay cannot prove fixture readiness, exact state/seed/build provenance or deterministic lifecycle completion.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Development HTML5 has an engine-owned QA request/bridge path while release settings explicitly disable it.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: game.properties defines bebee.qa_enabled; development.settings sets it to 1, release.settings sets it to 0, and app/bootstrap.script only initializes window.__bebeeQA when the runtime flag and HTML5 API are available.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The HTML5 build path binds runtime evidence to the exact source commit rather than trusting external PR prose.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tools/defold/bundle_html5.py resolves a full Git HEAD SHA (or validates an explicit full SHA override) and applies it through a second temporary Bob --settings file as bebee.build_commit_sha; the bridge reports that value.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The capture runner follows the BB-P008 isolation/readiness/provenance contract and can establish unchanged-state stability without inventing a global pixel threshold.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tools/visual_qa/capture_visual_qa.py uses a fresh Playwright Chromium BrowserContext per capture, waits for engineReady/captureReady, checks state/seed/build SHA, validates exact PNG dimensions, repeats every requested viewport at least twice and requires identical SHA-256 for foundation_probe.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The foundation does not falsely implement future gameplay QA states and has a reproducible local serve/tool dependency contract.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: config/visual-qa.json adds foundation_probe alongside the unchanged fifteen canonical gameplay/UI states; scripts/serve_html5.py provides the HTTP/wasm server and Playwright 1.62.0 is pinned and license-inventoried as test-only tooling.

automated: The existing Test and data workflow executes the new app.qa_runtime deterministic cases together with prior suites on the exact PR head.
Repository standards compile every Python file, validate JSON/text/dependency ledgers and reject source-layout drift on the exact PR head.
The separate BB-006 CI process PR is required to execute Playwright desktop/mobile captures, repeated stability and release bridge absence before BB-006 can be marked complete.
verification.runtime_errors: This harness PR does not claim retained Playwright runtime evidence by itself. Existing HTML5 CI must still build/smoke the changed bootstrap, while the scoped follow-up process PR supplies exact-head visual capture/runtime-error evidence before BB-006 closeout.
verification.save_data_impact: none; QA fixtures do not read player saves and BB-007 owns storage lifecycle proof

known_limitations: foundation_probe is intentionally infrastructure-only and does not satisfy movement_empty or any future player-facing state assertions.
Motion capture remains a later implementation item exactly as specified by BB-P008; BB-006 foundation proves still capture only.
CI workflow installation/execution of Playwright is intentionally isolated into a separate process PR to preserve the trusted governance boundary.
